Name: Brown-Haired Jodi
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
Has it ever bothered you that Jodi's portrait hair color is nothing like her sprite hair color? It always bothered me, and I couldn't find a mod that did exactly what I wanted, so I made one. Plus, with the prevalence of redheads in town, I thought it would be nice if her hair were light brown.

This mod makes her portrait hair be a light brown, just like her sprite, using Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Brown-Haired Jodi
Manifest.Description: Changes Jodi's portrait hair to match her sprite.
Manifest.Author: violetlizabet
